title: Ablauf über die Feiertage
seoTitle: Schedule over the holidays - DoctorBox Heimtests
html:
Notice for orders, lab analyses, and result transmissions during the holidays

Dear customer,

Here you’ll find all the important information on how the holidays affect orders and lab analyses:

  • Lab analyses: Lab analyses will only take place on 12/23 and 12/27 during the holidays. Samples received after 12/23 can only be processed starting 12/27.
  • Shipping of sample collection kits: Your sample collection kits will also be reliably shipped between the holidays so they’ll arrive on time.
  • Test results: Due to holiday schedules, your results may be delivered a bit later than usual.

Thank you for your understanding and patience during this time!

We wish you and your loved ones a wonderful holiday season, relaxing holidays, and a happy New Year! 🎄✨

Best regards,
Your DoctorBox Team
